description:
Set the tile players recognise the game by in the catalogue. Frames are screenshots FROM YOUR RUNNING GAME: we take them ourselves once the game is live at its own address, so they appear only AFTER release (`klyo_publish_game`), not during it. Call without `klatka` to get the list of available frames with their addresses; show them to the account owner, or look at them yourself and pick one that shows gameplay rather than the title screen. Then call again with its number. We deliberately do not accept a custom image as the main cover: the cover must show what the player will really see after clicking. Retouched art that does not match the game is a reason for taking the game down. COVER IN A LANGUAGE: with `jezyk` (pl, en, de, fr, es, pt, it, ru, uk, tr) this sets the cover shown on that language's game page, tiles and link previews. It is the language version of the main cover: the same picture, only its texts in that language, nothing invented; the game must really look like this, otherwise the game can be taken down. Send the image (PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 16 MB, 16:9, at least 1200 x 675, best 1920 x 1080; other shapes are cropped to 16:9 from the centre) with the ticket from klyo_upload_package, then call with `jezyk` and its `upload_id`, plus `alt`: one sentence in that language saying what the picture shows. `usun: true` goes back to the main cover (or to the klyo cover, where klyo made one for that language); `jezyk` alone lists which languages have their own cover and which show a klyo cover (`od_klyo`). It is public at once, like the main cover.

Examples:
• Show frames to choose from for the cover of lantern-thief
• Set the second frame as my game's cover
• My game has no image in the catalogue, fix it

alt.description: With `jezyk`: one sentence in that language saying what the picture shows (the image description Google and screen readers read).

jezyk.description: Cover in one language instead of the main cover: the language version of the main cover (the same picture with its texts in that language).

klatka.description: Number of the frame to set. OMIT it to get the list of frames to choose from first.

slug.description: Game address on the account, for example lantern-thief (from klyo_my_games).

upload_id.description: With `jezyk`: the image sent with the ticket from klyo_upload_package (PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 16 MB, 16:9, at least 1200 x 675).

usun.description: With `jezyk`: remove the cover in this language; its pages go back to the main cover, or to the klyo cover where klyo made one.

name: klyo_game_cover
title: Game cover in the catalogue
